home.title: Transcribe
home.description: Upload audio, pick a model, get a transcript with word-level timings.
home.drop: Drop a file here, or click to choose
home.dropHint: wav, mp3, m4a, flac, ogg, opus and anything else ffmpeg reads — up to {{limit}}
home.diarizeHint: Label who is speaking; needs the server to have diarization models
home.hotwordsHint: Comma-separated words the model should hear more readily
home.noModelsHint: Download one from the catalog — here, or on the models page.
home.punctuateHint: This model writes sentence marks and capitals itself
home.itnHint: Spelled-out numbers, money and dates into digits
home.numSpeakersHint: 0 lets the server work it out from the audio
home.dictionariesHint: Stored phrase lists. Managed on the Dictionaries screen.
home.languageHint: A locale from the list, or automatic. Automatic is decided for each stretch of speech on its own, so a short phrase can come out in the wrong script — pin the language when you know it.

models.title: Models
models.adminOnly: Managing models needs an admin key
models.confirmUnloadBody: Requests already running finish on the old copy. The next request loads it again.
models.actionFailed: The action did not go through

hotwords.title: Hotword dictionaries
hotwords.description: Phrase lists recognition is biased towards. A request names a dictionary by key instead of carrying the list.
hotwords.searchHint: By key, name, description and the phrases themselves
hotwords.emptyHint: Create one, or upload a file of phrases — one per line.
hotwords.noMatchesHint: The search looks inside the phrases too, not only at the names.
hotwords.modelsNone: None of the installed models can be biased. Dictionaries can still be prepared — they will apply once a model that supports it is installed.
hotwords.policyOn: Biasing is on, default strength {{score}}. 1.5–2.0 is the working range: above it the model starts inserting listed phrases where they were not said.
hotwords.policyOff: Dictionaries are stored but not applied
hotwords.policyDisabled: Set postproc.hotwords.enabled in the configuration — and asr.variants.max has to be above zero.
hotwords.policyNoVariants: asr.variants.max is zero. Biasing needs a second resident copy of the model, and that setting is its budget.
hotwords.keyHint: Lowercase latin letters, digits, dashes and underscores. This is the name a request uses: hotwords_dict=key
hotwords.name: Name
hotwords.phrasesHint: One per line. Repeats and blank lines are dropped on save.
hotwords.confirmDeleteBody: Requests naming its key will start failing.
hotwords.confirmDeleteStanding: This dictionary is named in the configuration (postproc.hotwords.default_dictionaries) and applies to every request. Deleting it leaves the server warning on every request until the name is removed from the configuration.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.emptyHint: Send a file to be transcribed and it will show up here.

result.title: Result
result.noAudio: The audio is not in this tab
result.noAudioHint: The file never leaves your browser and is not kept on the server, so a reload loses it. The transcript below is unaffected.
result.wrongFileHint: Its length does not match the transcript. The timings will not line up.
result.peaksLong: Long file — the waveform covers the first {{minutes}} minutes
result.speakersHint: Who spoke how much; a card hides and shows that speaker’s turns.

isolate.title: Voice isolation
isolate.description: Upload a recording, listen to and name the voices found, isolate one or all of them — or transcribe the conversation by speaker.
isolate.sessionDescription: Listen to the voices, name them and take them as tracks — or transcribe the conversation by speaker.
isolate.off: Voice isolation is not enabled on this server
isolate.offHint: For the administrator: isolation.enabled together with diarization.enabled in the configuration, and `nanoasr models pull voxlock-int8`.
isolate.privacy: The recording stays on the server while you work with it: up to an hour after the last action, or until you delete it.
isolate.voicesHint: A sample is exactly the 3 seconds the model knows the voice by. Wrong voice? Point it somewhere else.
isolate.noSample: No sample: {{reason}}. Say where to take one from.
isolate.sampleFromHint: 3 seconds where only this voice speaks; no later than {{max}}
isolate.gone: This recording is no longer on the server
isolate.goneHint: Recordings for isolation are kept for a limited time and deleted when the server restarts. Upload the file again.
isolate.delete: Delete the recording from the server
isolate.keepRecordingHint: The recording, tracks, names and transcript stay on the server until you delete them — across restarts too.
isolate.privacyKept: The recording stays on the server until you delete it.
isolate.yoursHint: The kept ones and those that have not expired yet.
isolate.transcribeTrackHint: This voice alone, as a job of its own; the result opens on the transcript page.
isolate.bySpeakersHint: Every voice is isolated and transcribed alone, then everything is merged into one conversation with names. Lines spoken at once are kept for both.
isolate.transcriptDescription: The conversation with its speakers' names: listen to the whole recording or to one voice.
isolate.transcriptStale: Tracks were isolated again after the transcript was made — it may not match them.
isolate.noTranscriptHint: Start “Transcribe by speaker” on the voices page.
isolate.speakersHint: Who spoke how much. A name can be changed right here — it shows in the conversation and the exports at once.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Language, theme, API key and display thresholds.
settings.apiKeyHint: Kept in this browser and sent only to this server. Leave empty if the server runs without authentication.
settings.apiKeyRequiredHint: API requests are refused without one. Enter it to carry on.
settings.confidenceHint: Words below this are underlined with a dotted rule. 0 underlines nothing.
